issues.body: contexts_from_pairs reads indices 0 and 1 but never checks pair.length() == 2. Consequently [url, documentText, extra] is accepted, while the function and public API documentation say malformed entries that are not two-string arrays are rejected. This does not undermine context-resolution soundness, but it makes the validation contract inaccurate and leaves the malformed-input coverage incomplete.
issues.fix_hint: Either reject pairs whose length is not exactly 2 and add a wasm test for an overlong pair, or revise the documentation to state that the first two elements are consumed and extras are ignored.
issues.title: Context entries are not validated to contain exactly two elements

verdict.summary: The opt-in feature is correctly isolated, the loader resolves only caller-supplied context URLs and fails closed on misses, and both native and real-wasm tests exercise the load-bearing resolution and JS-boundary error paths. The public-surface documentation and CI coverage are updated consistently. One minor validation mismatch remains: entries longer than two elements are accepted despite the documented exact pair shape.
